## HUKLLA T11 — DOI-title CI gate (postmortem follow-up)

### Incident background

During v12/v13 publication, `zenodo.20173912` (v13) and `zenodo.20173920` (v12) were
transiently confused in a README badge update. The swap nearly rode out into the published
record. This tripwire closes that failure mode permanently.

**DOI truth-table (canonical):**
| DOI | Version |
|-----|---------|
| `10.5281/zenodo.20173912` | v13 |
| `10.5281/zenodo.20173920` | v12 |
| `10.5281/zenodo.20162352` | Ouroboros runtime v6.3.0 |
| `10.5281/zenodo.19944926` | Concept DOI (Lutar Invariant family) |

### What this workflow does (HUKLLA T11)

1. **Runs on every push to `main` and every PR** — catches drift before merge.
2. **Parses `README.md`** for all `zenodo.NNNN` or `10.5281/zenodo.NNNN` patterns.
3. For each DOI:
   - Verifies `doi.org` resolution returns HTTP 2xx (detects dead/mis-typed DOIs).
   - Fetches `https://zenodo.org/api/records/NNNN` and checks `.metadata.title` exists.
   - Extracts the version token from the title (e.g. `v13`, `v6.3.0`).
   - Cross-checks the version the README claims for that DOI against the Zenodo record title.
4. **Fails hard** (`exit 1`) on any mismatch with a `::error::` annotation visible in the PR check UI.

### Failure message format

```
DOI-TITLE MISMATCH: zenodo.XXXX — README claims vY but Zenodo title says vZ
```

### References
- HUKLLA doctrine: `docs/HUKLLA.md` (T11 section)
- Postmortem: v12/v13 DOI swap — zenodo.20173912 vs zenodo.20173920
- Author: Lutar, Stephen P. | ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0001-0110-4173
title: feat(huklla T11): DOI-title CI gate (postmortem follow-up)

Fixes CITATION.cff name-particle leak across the org. Per the CFF spec, name-particle is for surname infixes (de/van/von) — not initials. Merges "P." into given-names as "Stephen P." and adds canonical email stephen@szlholdings.com.

Part of the Series-A doctrine cleanup (see audit report).
title: doctrine(citation): merge P. into given-names; add email
